mail.M1.subject: Your {plan} plan is active
mail.M1.active: Thank you. Your {plan} plan is active now.
mail.M1.price: You pay {totalAmount} a month, tax included. The plan renews on {renewDate} and then every month until you cancel.
mail.M1.cancel: You can cancel at any time in Settings, or without signing in on this page: {cancelPageUrl}
mail.M1.withdrawal: If you live in the EU, the EEA or the UK, you may withdraw within {withdrawalDays} days. You then pay only for the part already used: the larger of the days used or the credit used. The model withdrawal form is attached to this email.
mail.M1.termsAttached: The Terms you accepted are attached. The latest version is always at {termsUrl}
mail.M1.termsCurrent: Our current Terms are online at {termsUrl}
mail.M2.subject: Your DebateAI receipt for {totalAmount}
mail.M2.charged: We charged {totalAmount} for your {plan} plan on {chargeDate}.
mail.M2.invoiceAttached: Your invoice {invoiceNumber} is attached to this email.
mail.M2.invoiceInSettings: Your invoice number is {invoiceNumber}. It is listed in Settings, under Subscription. For a copy, write to {merchantEmail}.
mail.M3.subject: The price of your {plan} plan is changing
mail.M3.change: From {chargeDate}, your {plan} plan costs {totalAmount} a month, tax included. Until then, nothing changes.
mail.M3.cancel: If you do not want to continue, cancel before that date in Settings or on this page: {cancelPageUrl}
mail.M4.subject: A yearly reminder about your {plan} plan
mail.M4.reminder: Your {plan} plan renews every month for {totalAmount}, tax included. The next renewal is on {renewDate}.
mail.M4.cancel: You can cancel at any time in Settings or on this page: {cancelPageUrl}
mail.M5.subject: We couldn't take the payment for your {plan} plan
mail.M5.notTaken: We couldn't take this month's payment for your {plan} plan. You keep your plan while we try again.
mail.M5.confirmCard: Your bank asked you to confirm this payment. Please confirm your card in Settings, and we'll try again.
mail.M5.retry: We will try again on {retryDate}. To use a different card, open: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M5.secondTry: Our second try did not work either. We will try again on {retryDate}. To use a different card, open: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M5.lastTry: We will make one last try on {retryDate}. If it fails, your account moves to the Free plan, and your debates are kept. To use a different card, open: {cardPageUrl}
mail.M6.subject: Your account is now on the Free plan
mail.M6.moved: We could not take the payment for your {plan} plan, so your account is now on the Free plan. Your debates are kept.
mail.M6.again: You can choose a plan again at any time: {pricingUrl}
mail.M7.subject: Your {plan} plan is cancelled
mail.M7.until: You keep your {plan} plan until {accessEndDate}. You will not be charged again.
mail.M7.undo: Changed your mind? You can undo this in Settings before that date: {settingsUrl}
mail.M7.endedNow: Your {plan} plan ended on {accessEndDate}. You will not be charged again.
mail.M7.again: You can choose a plan again at any time in Settings: {settingsUrl}
mail.M7.paused: Your {plan} plan won't renew, and you won't be charged again. Its paid features stay paused while the payment dispute is open. If the dispute ends in your favour, you can use them until {accessEndDate}.
mail.M8.subject: Your withdrawal is confirmed
mail.M8.refunded: Your {plan} plan has ended, and we refunded {refundAmount} to your card. Your bank may take a few days to show it.
mail.M8.nothingDue: Your {plan} plan has ended. The part you already used covers the whole price, so nothing was due back to you.
mail.M8.nothingMoreDue: Your {plan} plan has ended, and nothing more is due back to you.
mail.M8_RECEIVED.subject: We've received your withdrawal
mail.M8_RECEIVED.received: We received your withdrawal from your {plan} plan on {withdrawalDate}. Your plan has ended.
mail.M8_RECEIVED.refunding: We're refunding {refundAmount} to your card and will email you again when it's done.
mail.M8_RECEIVED.ownerReview: A refund was already made on one of your payments, so we'll check what is still due and email you within 14 days.
mail.M9.subject: Your link to cancel your DebateAI plan
mail.M9.link: Open this link and press the button on the page to cancel your plan. The link works once, for 24 hours: {cancelLinkUrl}
mail.M9.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Nothing changes.
mail.M10.subject: Your paid features are paused
mail.M10.paused: Your bank told us that a payment for your {plan} plan is disputed. Paid features are paused while the dispute is open. Your debates are kept.
mail.M10.contact: If this is a mistake, write to us at {merchantEmail}.
mail.M11.subject: We couldn't accept your card
mail.M11.refunded: We can't accept cards issued in that card's country, so the {refundAmount} taken or held on it goes back to your card in full.
mail.M11.planEnded: Because of this, your {endedPlan} plan has ended and your account is now on the Free plan. Your debates are kept.
mail.M11_DUPLICATE.subject: We refunded your payment
mail.M11.duplicate: A payment of {refundAmount} arrived that we could not apply, so we refunded it in full. Your account keeps the plan it has now.
mail.withdrawalForm.title: Model withdrawal form
mail.withdrawalForm.instruction: Complete and return this form only if you wish to withdraw from the contract.
mail.withdrawalForm.notice: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the provision of the following service: the DebateAI subscription.
mail.withdrawalForm.name: Name: ____________
mail.withdrawalForm.signature: Signature (only if this form is sent on paper): ____________
